# Fixture: AI creditworthiness use case

A financial institution proposes an AI workflow that evaluates natural-person credit applicants, predicts probability of default, suggests credit scores, and recommends manual-underwriting priority. The system is not exclusively used for fraud detection. It uses application data, bureau attributes, transaction data, and model-derived reason-code suggestions.

Expected skills: ai-use-case-intake, ai-risk-tiering, ai-act-triage, model-card-builder, validation-plan, agentic-ai-controls.
